rationale: Two generic render-backend fixes. SkiaSurface's readback flush now judges Graphite's InsertStatus as end_frame() does, so a rejected recording fails the capture instead of returning stale texture pixels, and wait_for_submitted_work() reports the submit result; pixel output of accepted frames is unchanged. The chart-shader draw rect is padded by its declared reach, so a glow or outer feather paints past the shape rect instead of being cut off there, and a glow or outer feather whose reach is under 3 sigma is refused on the chart path (draw_with_sksl still accepts a short reach). The knob's chart draw now carries the feather declared with its shader geometry, so feathered knob charts change pixels inside the knob too, and a knob chart refused for a short reach falls through to the knob's body shader instead of painting the clipped chart. Pulp continues to own these targets under the 2026-10-04 design-import refactor inheritance decision; Vellum inherits both when the targets adopt the Vellum package. No design-import, Chromium, rendering or packaging authority moves.
tests: ctest --test-dir build -R 'SDF chart glow paints past the shape rect out to its reach'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'SkiaSurface readback fails when Graphite rejects the flushed recording'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'WidgetBridge knob chart glow paints outside the widget rect'
